# libarchive / libarchive_seek_fuzzer

libarchive's own fuzz target `libarchive_seek_fuzzer` ([source](source/libarchive_seek_fuzzer.cc), unmodified), one of the targets OSS-Fuzz builds, over libarchive (libarchive/libarchive at 3670ecf7).

Reads zip_seekable/7zip/rar/rar5/iso9660 (+ all filters) through read/seek/skip callbacks over the input (4 KiB chunks, clamped seeks); per entry (<= 50) calls pathname and size and drains archive_read_data, which may seek. Nothing compared.

## How this program differs from what OSS-Fuzz runs
- Linked against libarchive at commit 3670ecf7.
- In every build, getenv() returns NULL, getpid() returns 1 and mkstemp() uses a fixed name, so the program depends only on its input.
- A small driver reads the input file, calls the harness one to four times and prints each return value.

## What the harness checks
The harness makes no check of its own beyond not crashing, so a statement about it says only that the code it calls never crashes, hangs or trips a sanitizer.
